content:
alana_sales: Hey team — ACME is asking for SOC 2 artifacts for the POC. They want a copy of the latest report, a short bridge/ack letter if possible, and a presigned S3 link for selected evidence. Can we do this before the demo next Tue?
ryan_security: We can provide SOC 2 Type II extracts and a bridge note, but only after NDA signed and Legal okays scope. Typical flow: NDA -> redacted extract bundle via presigned S3 (7d expiry) -> bridge note (management assertion + controls update).
lee_legal: @alana_sales please share ACME contact and the NDA template they prefer. We need signatures before we hand over evidence. Also note: bridge letters are not a substitute for a full report; record that in the email to customer.
jordan_eng: For the POC itself do we need production-level logs? We can provide sanitized traces and a minimal config snapshot. If they need full system-level evidence that contains IP or internal hostnames, we'd have to redact heavily.
alana_sales: ACME contact is sam@acme-corp.com. They asked for any auditor name & date ranges too. What's the SOC 2 period we can cite?
ryan_security: Latest SOC 2 Type II period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, auditor: Brightpoint LLP. We can state that and offer a redacted extract package (control narratives + test samples).
lee_legal: I'll approve NDA language for a standard mutual NDA. For bridge-letter wording, Legal prefers: "temporary acknowledgement of control posture and limited scope; not a replacement for full SOC 2 report" — we'll sign and timestamp it.
alana_sales: Timeline: demo Tue 10am PT. Can we get NDA signed by Fri and evidence bundle by Mon morning? ACME needs time to review before demo.
jordan_eng: If they only need POC-level artifacts (sanitized logs + infra snapshot + control summaries) we can assemble those by Mon. I'll coordinate redaction.
ryan_security: Two notes: 1) presigned S3 links will expire in 7 days by default — we can extend to 14 on case-by-case with justification. 2) We will not share raw user data; only synthetic or redacted samples.
redwood-bot: file uploaded: "soc2_extracts/redacted_control_narrative_2024-12-31.pdf" (access requires NDA)
lee_legal: Alana please send the NDA to Sam and CC me. Once countersigned, I'll return signed bridge letter and instruct Security to upload presigned link.
alana_sales: Sending NDA now. Email snippet for handoff: 
```
Hi Sam,
Thanks for the interest. Attached is our mutual NDA. Once we have that signed back, we'll send a redacted SOC 2 extract bundle and a short bridge letter outlining our current coverage (auditor, period, and controls in scope). Presigned links will expire by default in 7 days.
Best,
Alana
```
ryan_security: Also to ACME: if they need evidence of specific control tests, ask them to list control IDs (e.g., CC1, CC6) — that speeds redaction and export.
alana_sales: Confirmed. I'll ask them for specific control items. Thanks all :thumbsup:
